# Relative link helper produces correct relative paths

The rel_link helper constructs relative .md links between slug identifiers (examples: rel_link('api/get-x','component/y') -> '../component/y.md'; rel_link('component/a','component/b') -> 'b.md'). The test asserts these exact behaviors.
